title: Torna a Surriento
artist: Ernesto De Curtis / Giambattista De Curtis
attribution: Neapolitan song with music by Ernesto De Curtis (died 1937) and words by his brother Giambattista De Curtis (died 1926), associated with 1902 and officially copyrighted in 1905. Public domain: published before 1931 (United States) and all authors died before 1972 (Canada). The verse moves from D minor to D major, so the major-key bars show notes outside the key.
